evals.prompt: 我朋友的 Windows 笔记本是 RTX 4060 8GB 显存、32GB 内存、1TB 硬盘，想本地跑 Claude Code 和翻译，应该装什么模型、用什么推理后端？请先给方案，不要直接下载。
evals.expected_output: Hardware report, Tier C/D, Gemma 4 12B / Qwen3.5-9B or 4B, no 35B as primary, Ollama or llama.cpp, translation model, download sizes, confirmation before downloads; if a 30B/35B-A3B is mentioned, flag it as borderline on 8GB + 32GB.

evals.prompt: MacBook Pro M3 Pro 18GB 统一内存，想搭本地 AI 通用智能体，能跑什么模型？用 Ollama、MLX 还是 LM Studio？
evals.expected_output: Apple Silicon unified-memory tier, Gemma 4 12B / Qwen3.5-9B, 35B not practical on 18GB, Ollama/MLX/LM Studio recommendation, Claude Code bridge caveats.

evals.prompt: Linux 服务器双 RTX 4090（共 48GB 显存）、128GB 内存，想给团队搭本地通用智能体和 Claude Code 代理，怎么选型和部署？
evals.expected_output: Tier S, Qwen3.8-27B or Qwen3.6-35B-A3B full GPU, a team-appropriate serving stack (vLLM/SGLang or llama.cpp with a concurrency explanation), Anthropic proxy or LiteLLM, 32K context, team/security considerations, download plan.

evals.prompt: 帮我清理一下 C 盘，把下载文件夹里的大文件找出来删掉。
evals.expected_output: This is a disk cleanup task, not a local AI setup task; the skill should not trigger.
